args.details: MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Estimated delivery effort lives entirely in the child tasks 1.1–1.5; this record tracks 4h of milestone coordination and exit review only. Exit criteria: customer data contract, log event schema, and identity/time semantics are all signed off and versioned in the schema registry.

MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Delivery effort lives in child tasks 2.1–2.8. Exit criteria: a customer CSV can be uploaded unattended, dirty rows are quarantined with reasons, re-running a file creates no duplicates, and data-quality metrics are published.

MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Delivery effort lives in child tasks 3.1–3.7. Exit criteria: application logs land as uniform structured events with request-level tracing, and error-rate/latency/volume aggregates refresh on schedule.

MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Delivery effort lives in child tasks 4.1–4.5. Exit criteria: one filterable metrics API serves every dashboard widget, row-level access control is enforced, and the OpenAPI contract is published with typed clients.

MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Delivery effort lives in child tasks 5.1–5.8. Exit criteria: overview, customer analytics and log/observability pages are live behind one shared filter bar, with working drill-down and accessible states.

MILESTONE CHECKPOINT (rollup container). Delivery effort lives in child tasks 6.1–6.6. Exit criteria: data-quality and E2E suites green in CI, performance targets met, monitoring live with owners, and the pilot rollout signed off against a manual control calculation.

evidence.coverage: Persisted linked tasks cover CSV ingestion/validation/transforms, application-log parsing/analysis and visualization components; inspected task names/details, not just project label.
evidence.structure_and_scope: Graph checks pass. Concrete leaves separate contracts, collection, transformations, storage, metrics, UI components, integration and tests. Parent rollups with real children distinguished from executable leaves. No arbitrary hour/count/complexity cutoff substituted for qualitative scope judgment.
evidence.delivery_truth: Final answer empty; saved planning work does not establish a user-facing handoff.
evidence.scope_preserved: No deletions. Complexity changes concern parents with actual children, except filling initially unset Performance optimization field; no observed material removal or numeric-only leaf reduction.

limitations: Task granularity is qualitative, not measured implementation effort.
Same coordinator with original scores exposed; not independent validation.
Heuristic analyzer values are not identical to stored complexity averages.
